questions.stem: What are the two primary data processing layers in Lambda Architecture?
questions.explanation: Lambda Architecture divides processing into a Batch Processing Layer and a Real-Time (event-based) Processing Layer.

questions.stem: In which formal system is Lambda Architecture said to be grounded?
questions.explanation: Lambda Architecture is grounded in lambda calculus, a formal system in mathematical logic based on function abstraction, application and variable substitution.

questions.stem: How does the Batch Processing Layer decide when to process data?
options: The instant each record is generated
Only when a user requests a report
Whenever a real-time event triggers it
At scheduled intervals, from once a day to every few minutes, or when volume and resources allow
questions.explanation: Batch processing is not triggered as data is generated; it runs on a set schedule or when data volume and system resources allow.

questions.stem: By what other name is the Real-Time Processing Layer known?
questions.explanation: The Real-Time Processing Layer, also called event-based processing, handles data the moment it is generated.

questions.stem: Historically, why was the 'daily batch' run after business hours?
options: To avoid system load during operational hours
Because real-time tools did not exist at all
Because storage was only available at night
To allow staff to review the data manually
questions.explanation: Data transfer happened once every 24 hours after business hours to avoid system load during operational hours, so reporting was based on the previous day's data.

questions.stem: Which developments are named as making Lambda Architecture more feasible in the Big Data era?
options: Open-source tools like Hadoop, object storage systems and NoSQL databases
questions.explanation: Open-source tools like Hadoop, object storage and NoSQL databases drastically reduced the cost and complexity of managing vast data volumes.

questions.stem: What is data sovereignty in the context of adopting cloud-based Lambda Architecture?
options: A cloud provider's ownership of customer data
The right of a user to delete their own records
A pricing model based on data volume
The encryption standard for data in transit
Regulatory requirements that data remain within a particular country or region
questions.explanation: Many industries operate under regulations mandating that data stay within a country or region, so cloud providers must establish data centres in those regions.

questions.stem: In a typical AWS Lambda Architecture pipeline, which service handles real-time ingestion?
questions.explanation: On AWS, data ingestion for real-time processing goes through Amazon Kinesis, with EMR or Glue for batch and S3 or Redshift for storage.

questions.stem: Which Google Cloud services are named for real-time streaming and batch processing respectively?
questions.explanation: Google Cloud Dataflow handles real-time streaming, integrating with Pub/Sub, while BigQuery is designed for large-scale batch processing and storage.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT named as an Azure tool supporting Lambda Architecture?
questions.explanation: Azure's named tools are Stream Analytics, Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB and Azure Functions; Kinesis is an AWS service.
